subject: Re: Pen test report & vuln management process — follow-up from today's call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finhealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test report & vuln management process — follow-up from today's call

Hi Alice —

Really appreciate you taking the time today. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed so your security team has what they need: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is currently in scope for SOC 2 Type II; testing window closes mid-April and we expect the final report in early May (ETA ~2026-05-10). We can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter in the interim if helpful.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We support HIPAA (BAA available) and have data processing addenda for GDPR. We treat ePHI fields as customer-controlled and can detail encryption/KMS options.
- Pen test: We run annual third-party penetration tests plus quarterly external vulnerability scans. You asked for our latest pen test summary — I attached a redacted summary (redwood_pen_test_summary_2026-03.pdf) and the SOW for ongoing vuln management (vuln_management_sow_2026.docx).
- Vulnerability SLAs & cadence (high level):
  * External scans: weekly automated scans + quarterly manual/runbook tests by a third party
  * Triage cadence: engineering triage daily during business hours; on-call coverage for critical findings
  * SLA targets: ack within 72 hours for critical findings; mitigation plan within 7 days; remediation timeline varies by severity (critical: immediate/hotfix; high: 30 days target; medium/low: 90 days target)
  * Disclosure: coordinated with customers; we do not publicly disclose until a fix or mitigation is available unless the customer requests disclosure earlier.

Next steps we agreed on:
1) I’ll start the vendor security questionnaire from your side (OneTrust link) and share a read-only copy of the pen test summary.
2) Rishi will join a technical deep-dive next week to walk through scanning outputs and our remediation workflow (suggest Wed/Thu).
3) If you want an unredacted pen test report, we can do a controlled sharing via a secure DLP link after an NDA — let me know the preferred process.

Attachments: redwood_pen_test_summary_2026-03.pdf (redacted), vuln_management_sow_2026.docx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the OneTrust questionnaire link and a proposed time for the technical review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: FinHealth Security <security@finhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test report & vuln management process — follow-up from today's call

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our reviewers: 

1) Can you confirm whether the pen test summary includes exploitation details for critical findings or is it high-level only? Our security team usually requests technical details for validation (we can sign an NDA if needed).
2) For the SLA language: can you provide the formal text you put into your SOW for critical/high sev SLAs (ack / fix / mitigation timelines)? We need the contractual commitments to evaluate against our procurement checklist.
3) For SOC 2: when you say "final report in early May" — do you have an exact delivery date or a copy you can share under NDA?

We'd like to kick off the vendor security questionnaire today. Also please confirm whether Redwood will accept vulnerability reports from our 3rd-party security assessor (we prefer to use our vendor for recurring tests).

If Rishi can do the tech walkthrough on Thursday morning PST that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Morgan
Director, Security Engineering | FinHealth
alice.morgan@finhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test report & vuln management process — follow-up from today's call

Hi Alice —

Great questions — answers below and a couple of doc links.

1) Pen test detail level: the attached PDF is a redacted executive summary we share publicly. For technical details (exploit traces, PoCs) we require an NDA + secure delivery; once the NDA is in place we can share a controlled, unredacted copy via our secure file transfer. If your assessor needs raw output (nmap/nessus/etc.), we can coordinate sharing or provide our scan exports.

2) SLA language (excerpt we typically include in the SOW):
   - "Critical/CVSS >= 9.0: Initial acknowledgement within 72 hours and mitigation plan within 7 calendar days. If a hotfix is required, Redwood will deploy remediation or temporary mitigation as soon as feasible and provide daily status updates until resolved."
   - "High/CVSS 7.0 - 8.9: Target remediation within 30 calendar days with documented mitigation steps and verification testing."
   - "Medium/Low: Target remediation within 90 calendar days; exceptions documented and approved by security PM."

3) SOC 2: final auditor sign-off is tentatively scheduled for 2026-05-10. We can provide a bridge letter in the meantime and will share the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA as soon as it is available.

4) Third-party assessors: yes — we accept vulnerability reports from customer-appointed third-party assessors. We ask two things: (1) the assessor follow our reporting template (we can share), and (2) run tests during an agreed maintenance window for any intrusive tests. We'll also add your assessor as a recognized vendor in our intake process so their findings map into our Jira backlog and SLAs.

5) Questionnaire: I started the OneTrust questionnaire for FinHealth (link: https://onetrust.example.com/questionnaire/finhealth-2026). You'll see a "Redwood response" view and a place where you can add your assessor's contact if you want them to submit findings directly.

Next steps:
- I attached the redacted pen test summary and the SOW. If you confirm NDA, I'll route the unredacted report to your security inbox.
- Rishi: are you available Thu 10:30 AM PST for the technical walkthrough?

Thanks — looping Steph to schedule procurement docs if needed.

Best,
Marissa
